_doc: The rival smith (GDD 4.5.5) [balance]. H3 uses: sell_min_demand (sells an item while its demand is >= this; the difficulty's rival_sell_min_demand replaces it), gold_reserve (keeps this much when buying inputs), work_mode, work_phases (produces only then), decide_on (when it thinks: at dawn and at every phase change), buy_days (inputs for this many days of work), accepts_contracts (takes contracts from the board), max_contracts (contracts it holds at a time, under the board's max_accepted_per_family; GDD: "acepta uno"), accepts_scripted_contracts (false: it leaves the scripted start contracts to the player). weights/aggression/risk_aversion/rivalry_threshold/preferred_professions are for the family AI of H6 (GDD 4.21).
_h13_doc: H13 (04c 4.21.7.2): weights, aggression, rivalry_threshold, expansion, reserve_days, attack_bias y spouse_title_bonus los lee solo la hostilidad (sim/ai/hostility.gd), en los mapas de data/ai.json hostility_maps (Bellcaire): en Vilarrasa no cambia nada. risk_aversion se queda en 0,5 (04c dice 0,6) porque los duelos de Vilarrasa ya la leen.
_title_rule_doc: H9 [provisional, until 04c is approved]: requests = asks for the next title at the town hall when it meets its requirements and keeps spare_gold after paying it (RivalAI task title).
_office_rule_doc: H10 [provisional, until 04c is approved]: runs = registers (RivalAI task office, a management order) for the first office of offices whose election is open, that its title allows and that nobody of the family already holds or runs for, when it can pay the level and keep spare_gold.
_accuse_doc: H11 [provisional, until 04c is approved]: initial_attitudes = the family's attitudes at a new game (GDD 4.2.3; 04c, the stubborn artisan). accuse_rule: accuses the player's family with a public fact not yet tried against it (real_facts) or, if its honesty <= fabricate_max_honesty, with fabricated proofs (stealth check); never in the first protect_days days of the game; once every cooldown_days days.
_tavern_table_doc: posada (04f §4.27.4): si esta familia es dueña de una taberna, quién se sienta a su mesa de juego desde la puerta: no deja a quien su cabeza tenga en relación < refuse_below; pide rival_min_stake a quien tenga < rival_below, si no min_stake.
